releaseNotes: Cleaner Search: compact language selector and source tabs, recent search chips, equal category cards, consistent mini-player margins and smaller navigation icons. Existing music functionality retained.
limitations: Physical-device upgrade, background playback and two-phone room acceptance required
Intro markers apply only to confirmed imported audio; no online sponsor/ad removal
Accounts, push notifications and authorized YouTube library sync need project setup
Licensed lyric search, complete transliteration, popularity/audio metadata and authorized online downloads remain dependencies
